notes:
## Fixes

- Edit wall: the Save changes and Cancel buttons at the top of the window now respond to a click (before, only Enter and Esc worked).
- Media Walls: the search box, sort list and New wall button at the top of the window now respond to a click.
- Edit wall: an empty zone now says where scenes can be dragged from (the queue or another zone).
linuxNotes:
First Linux preview of Video Shelf: the whole app on Ubuntu and similar systems (.deb). It uses the same catalogue as the Windows app.

Install with:

    sudo apt install ./videoshelf_0.12.0_amd64.deb
